A Look-up Table for the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology

Source: R/data.R
IUCN_GET_LUT.Rd

The IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (GET) is the first internationally agreed framework for describing and mapping the world's ecosystems. This is a Look-up Table generated from the Global Ecosystem Typology vocabulary at https://w3id.org/iucn-get/IUCNEcosystemTypology.

Usage

IUCN_GET_LUT

Format

A data frame with 9 columns:

efg

Character vector with urls of the permanent ID of the concept in the vocabulary

efg_id

Character vector of short code for the ecosystem functional groups (level 3 in the classification)

efg_name

Character vector of the name for the ecosystem functional groups (level 3 in the classification)

biome_id

Character vector of short code for the functional biomes (level 2 in the classification)

biome_name

Character vector of the name for the functional biomes (level 2 in the classification)

realm_id

Character vector of short code for the realms (level 1 in the classification)

realm_name

Character vector of the name for the realms (level 1 in the classification)

version

Character vector with version name

version_date

Character vector with date version was uploaded or updated

Source

Keith, D. A., J. R. Ferrer-Paris et al. (2022) A function-based typology for Earth’s ecosystems Nature 610, 513–518. DOI:10.1038/s41586-022-05318-4.

See also

Other data: TASVEG_LUT, TASVEG_mini, TASVEG_mini_expert_wide, TASVEG_xref
